title: Robustness Beyond Known Groups with Low-rank Adaptation
measurement_description: Evaluated model robustness and worst-group accuracy for subgroups defined by religious identity (Christian, Muslim, other religion) in a toxicity classification task using the CivilComments dataset.
findings: In experiments on the CivilComments dataset, which includes religious identity as a demographic attribute, the proposed method (LEIA) demonstrated improved worst-group accuracy for underrepresented groups. When using 'Muslim' as the single known attribute for hyperparameter tuning and early stopping, LEIA achieved the highest worst-group accuracy (65.2±1.8) across all demographic intersections compared to baseline methods.
